en.answer: Provided there is only an opponent's monster in the Extra Monster Zone, you can Special Summon both copies of <<13195>> during the same turn.
en.question: My opponent's <<13085>> is the only monster in an Extra Monster Zone. If there are 2 copies of <<13195>> in my hand, can I Special Summon both with their effects?
